title: 週末去爬山
summary: Climbing Elephant Mountain for a view of Taipei 101.
paragraphs: 這個週末天氣很好，我和朋友去爬象山。
象山不太高，可是有很多樓梯，我們爬了半個小時。
到了山上，我們可以看到臺北一〇一。
風景很漂亮，我們拍了很多照片。
下山以後，我們去吃牛肉麵，又累又開心。
translation: The weather was great this weekend, so my friend and I went hiking on Elephant Mountain.
Elephant Mountain isn't very high, but there are a lot of stairs. We climbed for half an hour.
At the top we could see Taipei 101.
The view was beautiful, and we took lots of photos.
After coming down we went for beef noodles, tired but happy.

glossary.象山: Elephant Mountain, a hill in Taipei's Xinyi District
